per_case_results.question: List out the account numbers of female clients who are oldest and has lowest average salary, calculate the gap between this lowest average salary with the highest average salary?
per_case_results.expected_sql: SELECT T1.account_id, (SELECT MAX(A11) - MIN(A11) FROM district) FROM account AS T1 INNER JOIN district AS T2 ON T1.district_id = T2.district_id INNER JOIN disp AS T3 ON T1.account_id = T3.account_id INNER JOIN client AS T4 ON T3.client_id = T4.client_id WHERE T2.district_id = (SELECT district_id FROM client WHERE gender = 'F' ORDER BY birth_date ASC NULLS FIRST LIMIT 1) ORDER BY T2.A11 DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1
per_case_results.actual_sql:
SELECT
  T1."account_id",
  (SELECT MAX("a11") FROM "district") - (SELECT MIN("a11") FROM "district")
FROM "account" AS T1
JOIN "disp" AS T2 ON T1."account_id"  =  T2."account_id"
JOIN "client" AS T3 ON T2."client_id"  =  T3."client_id"
JOIN "district" AS T4 ON T1."district_id"  =  T4."district_id"
WHERE T3."gender"  =  'F'
ORDER BY T3."birth_date" ASC, T4."a11" ASC
LIMIT 1

per_case_results.question: What was the growth rate of the total amount of loans across all accounts for a male client between 1996 and 1997?
per_case_results.expected_sql: SELECT CAST((SUM(CASE WHEN TO_CHAR(CAST(T1.date AS TIMESTAMP), 'YYYY') = '1997' THEN T1.amount ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN TO_CHAR(CAST(T1.date AS TIMESTAMP), 'YYYY') = '1996' THEN T1.amount ELSE 0 END)) AS REAL) * 100 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN TO_CHAR(CAST(T1.date AS TIMESTAMP), 'YYYY') = '1996' THEN T1.amount ELSE 0 END), 0) FROM loan AS T1 INNER JOIN account AS T2 ON T1.account_id = T2.account_id INNER JOIN disp AS T3 ON T3.account_id = T2.account_id INNER JOIN client AS T4 ON T4.client_id = T3.client_id WHERE T4.gender = 'M' AND T3.type = 'OWNER'
per_case_results.actual_sql:
SELECT 
    (SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l."date") = 1997 THEN l."amount" ELSE 0 END) - 
     SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l."date") = 1996 THEN l."amount" ELSE 0 END))::REAL / 
    NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l."date") = 1996 THEN l."amount" ELSE 0 END), 0) AS growth_rate
FROM "loan" l
JOIN "account" a ON l."account_id" = a."account_id"
JOIN "disp" d ON a."account_id" = d."account_id"
JOIN "client" c ON d."client_id" = c."client_id"
WHERE c."gender" = 'M'
LIMIT 500
